item.title: Review: McDonald's Moves on Makeover; Dick's Sporting Goods Up on Earnings | Stock Movers
item.description: On this episode of Stock Movers: - Anthropic (ANT) shares are lower and briefly traded below their $83 initial public offering price in premarket trading, wiping out gains for investors who piled into the artificial intelligence lab’s record-setting debut. - McDonald's (MCD) shares are moving on news the company's betting big on a makeover to win back customers. The chain is tearing down kitchen walls, adding hand-breaded chicken and trendy drinks, plus testing AI to take drive-thru orders.
